title: genista cephalantha var. mouilleronii
intro: Genista cephalantha var. mouilleronii, commonly known as Mouilleron's broom, is a shrub-like plant within the Fabaceae family, specifically a variety of the Genista cephalantha species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Genista cephalantha var. mouilleronii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can be beneficial in treating various conditions such as cardiovascular diseases and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
